verdict_rationale: ACCRUAL multi-axis composite FAILS all graduation criteria. (1) composite_beats_single=FALSE — composite ICIR 0.019 << best-single AC22 ICIR 0.260 (QMJ kill criterion: 합성<단일이면 무의미). (2) composite mean rank-IC 0.0014 (≈0), harvey-t(rank-IC) 0.166 << 3.0. (3) DSR 0.053 << 0.50 (beta-neutral alpha residual). (4) portfolio-alpha t 1.087 (NS). (5) realized_beta 0.897 — top25 EW basket is market-like, no defensive/orthogonal return structure. (6) return_cor vs STR_1715 = 0.806 despite signal cor -0.063 (BAB structural problem: signal orthogonal, returns not). Even the sole signal carrier AC22_Accrual_Volatility (harvey-t 2.26) fails the 3.0 gate. AX-003/AX-004 pattern confirmed: KR single-family long-only fails; composite did NOT rescue.

data_quality_findings: AC01_Total_Accruals_CF = AC11_Accruals_to_Assets = AC18_Accrual_Quality are IDENTICAL columns in Factor DB (cor=1.0). Raw 10-factor 'multi-axis' spec was inflating level+quality axes with the SAME series 3x.

AC22_Accrual_Volatility has only ~12 distinct values (low-cardinality, ranked) yet is the ONLY signal carrier (rank-IC 0.026, ICIR 0.26). Treat with suspicion — likely captures a stability/size proxy, not pure accrual mechanism.
Deduplicated to cluster representatives (level: AC01+AC10; quality: AC13+AC22+AC23; asseteff: AC05+AC24). Composite STILL ICIR 0.019.

composite_vs_best_single.conclusion: Composite is WORSE than best single by ~13.6x ICIR. Multi-axis aggregation destroys the only signal (AC22) by averaging it with 6 noise factors. QMJ교훈 위반 — 무의미.
